propositions: Bedrock client construction fails with NoRegionError because the review-bot container has no AWS region configured and boto3 cannot auto-discover it via IMDS
The region must be set explicitly via REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION in the container environment; AWS_REGION alone does not work with the current botocore version

build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, which triggers boto3's ambient resolution that fails; the raised pydantic_ai.exceptions.UserError is not caught by rebar's LLMError handlers

A pre-flight check using boto3.session.Session().region_name must validate region availability at provider construction and raise a typed LLMConfigError naming REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, not the ambiguous boto3 exception
IMDS reachability is orthogonal to region discovery; fixing IMDS does not supply a region, so both IMDS contingency and explicit region config are independent concerns
